summary: Learn CVA market assessment, payment controls, protection, and PDM through practical programme exercises. Explore the course outline.
lede: Cash and voucher assistance training helps humanitarian and social-protection teams plan accountable transfers around market conditions and people’s needs. It is for programme managers, cash-transfer officers, and finance, monitoring, and social-protection staff, covering market assessment, transfer-value decisions, and delivery-mechanism selection. Participants also practise protection-risk controls, payment reconciliation, complaints handling, and post-distribution monitoring with practical programme tools.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, deliver, monitor, protect, finance, or oversee cash and voucher assistance programmes.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Prior CVA experience is not required. Familiarity with programme-cycle work, beneficiary data, or humanitarian finance is useful. No coding is required; basic spreadsheet use supports the payment-tracking exercises. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software if you want to complete the digital-template activities directly.
